title: KBDocument
description: Schema for a knowledge base document chunk after ingestion. Every chunk in the vector database must conform to this schema. Used by the ingestion pipeline to validate data before embedding.

id.description: Unique identifier for this chunk. Format: {doc_name_slug}__chunk_{index:03d}

content.description: The actual text content of the chunk. Must be non-empty and contain meaningful text.

source.description: Relative path to the source markdown file, from the project root.

doc_name.description: Just the filename of the source document. Used for citations.

category.description: KB category this chunk belongs to. Must match a folder name in data/kb/.

chunk_index.description: Zero-indexed position of this chunk within its source document.

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks produced from the source document.

audience.description: Who this content is intended for. Extracted from the source document's metadata block.

last_updated.description: Date the source document was last updated (from its metadata block). ISO 8601 date format.

tags.description: Controlled vocabulary tags from data/taxonomy/tags.yaml. Between 2 and 8 tags per chunk.

token_count.description: Number of tokens in the chunk, measured with tiktoken (cl100k_base).

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this chunk was ingested into the vector database.

heading_path.description: Hierarchical path of headings from the source document (e.g., ['Return & Refund Policy', 'Refund Timeline']). Used for citation context.

keywords.description: Optional keywords extracted from this chunk for keyword-based search.

related_docs.description: Other KB documents referenced in this chunk (from `## Related` sections).

embedding_model.description: The embedding model used to vectorize this chunk.

embedding_dimensions.description: Number of dimensions in the embedding vector.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the content. Used for deduplication and change detection.

version.description: Schema version this chunk was validated against.

examples.content:
## Refund Timeline

Once we receive and inspect the returned item:

| Step | Timeframe |
|---|---|
| Carrier transit to our facility | 3–7 business days |
| Inspection | 1–2 business days |
| Refund approval | 1 business day |
| Refund processing to payment method | 5–7 business days |

**Total from ship-back to refund in your account: 10–17 business days.**

Refunds are issued to the **original payment method only**. We cannot issue refunds to a different card, bank account, or as cash.

## Common Questions

**Does the VoltBuds Pro have active noise cancellation (ANC)?**  
No. It has **passive noise isolation** only, which reduces ambient noise through the ear tip seal but does not actively cancel sound. For ANC, see the VoltBuds Pro+ (coming 2026).

**Can I use one earbud at a time?**  
Yes. Either the left or right earbud works independently for calls and music. This is useful for phone calls or when you need to stay aware of your surroundings.
